reason: Codec registry spans contracts and host video/session modules; keep responsibilities aligned.
Codec selection failures and fallback reasons must produce clear diagnostics.
Capability selection logic needs deterministic unit tests and scoped abstractions.
Codec decision and fallback reason must be visible in startup diagnostics without hot-path logging.
Shared codec names and selection helpers must be centralized rather than duplicated.
Host/device contract requires route-neutral extensible codec registry and shared selection behavior.
Existing VideoCodec enum and capability report are the likely registry compatibility point.
Session hello/config types currently carry VideoCodecDescriptor and selected codec values.
Existing host video path classification and packet decode behavior must stay compatible.
Existing codec normalization/selection should be replaced or wrapped by route-neutral registry selection.
CLI diagnostics should print selected codec and fallback reason while preserving route abstraction.
